description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice Under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply, which falls under regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. This does not involve government structure/personnel changes or any of the other specialized categories, making it a clear Legal/Regulatory gazette.
